arabic text: SISKIYAN ABHI SUNAYI DE RAHI HAI SAKINA KI QABAR\nSE
english translation text: Sakina’s sobs can still be\nheard from her grave.

arabic text: JO KEHTI HAI MERE BABA ME TANHA SO NAHIN SAKTI\nSHIMAR KE DAR SE
english translation text: She cries, ‘Father, I cannot sleep alone,\nfor I am afraid of Shimr.’

arabic text:
SAHE DUKHRE NA JANE QAID ME KYA KYA SAKINA NE
KE SINA BAAP KAAHI KHAAK KO SAMJHA SAKINA NE
NAHIN BETI KOI AISI UMAR SARI JO BABA KE
PYAAR KO TAR SE
english translation text:
Who knows what sufferings Sakina endured in prison? She
mistook the dust for her father’s chest. Never has
there been a daughter who, throughout her short
life, thirsted so deeply for her father’s love.

arabic text:
SAKINA NE KAHA BHAYYA MUJHE BABA SE MILWADO
MUJHE LEJAWO UNKE PAAS YA UNKO HI BULWADO
YE TANHAI SE BEHTAR TO ME RASTE ME HI MARJATI
THAK KE SAFAR SE
english translation text:
Sakina said, ‘Brother, take me to my father. Either
carry me to him or call him here. It
would have been better to die upon the road
than to be exhausted by this lonely journey.’

arabic text:
PHATTE CHOLAY ME ABID NE SAKINA KO JO DAFNAYA
MASUMA PE MUSALMANO KO KUCH BHI TARS NA AYA
WO GHURBAT THI MUHARI KI KE HAR PAL ASHK
AAKHON SE
KHOON KE BARSE
english translation text:
When Abid buried Sakina in her torn
clothes, the Muslims showed no mercy to
the innocent child. Such was the
helplessness of the camel-rider that blood-like
tears poured constantly from his eyes.

arabic text:
YE TOOTE PALCH KI KO ME ME KAB CHAYN PAUNGI
MUJHE LAGTA HAI ZINDAAN ME NA ROTI MAR HI
JAUNGI
PHUPHI ZAINAB BHI KEHTI HAI TUJHE TANHA HI
REHNA HAI
BETI SAFAR SE
english translation text:
‘When will I ever find rest
with these broken ribs? I feel
I will die weeping in this
prison. Aunt Zainab tells me, “My
daughter, you must remain alone
here when the caravan leaves.”’

arabic text: TAMACHE SHIMR NE MUNH PAY MERE MAQTAL ME\nMAARAY HAI\nMERE KANO ME JO THE GOSHWARE JO UTAARE HAI
english translation text: ‘Shimr struck my face with slaps\nin the battlefield and tore\nthe earrings from my ears.’

arabic text: MERA BABA BINA TERE GAYA MAT MUJH PE YE TOOTI\nPEHLE HASHAR SE
english translation text: ‘Father, without you calamity has fallen upon\nme even before the Day of Judgement.’

arabic text:
ALI KI BETIYON KA DARD HI MERI IBADAT HAI
ME PANJATAN KA GADAGAR HUN YE GHAZI KI INAYAT
HAI
MILI HAI BHEEK AKHTAR KO JAHAN ME NAWHAKHANI
KI
ZAHRA KE DAR SE
english translation text:
The grief of Ali’s daughters
is my worship. I am
a beggar of the Panjetan;
this is Ghazi’s favour. At
Zahra’s door, Akhtar was granted
the gift of lamentation.
